```{r}

# Base GitHub raw URL
base_url <- "https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest/raw/refs/heads/main/data/bundle_injury_overdose/dist/"

# Read and assign datasets with short names
d1 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "overdose_by_demographics.parquet"))
d2 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "overdose_by_geography_and_source.parquet"))
d3 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "overdose_by_geography_and_source_county.parquet"))
d4 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "overdose_by_geography_and_source_state_year.parquet"))
d5 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "overdose_deaths_county.parquet"))
d6 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "overdose_deaths_state.parquet"))
d7 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "state_opioid_by_source.parquet"))
d8 <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "overdose_by_demographics.parquet"))
```

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly) 

# Age groups to keep
age_keep <- c("15-24 Years", "25-44 Years", "45-64 Years", "65+ Years", "<15 Years")

# Filter dataset
d_filtered <- d4 %>%
  filter(age == "Total")

# Split into 2 datasets by source
d4_epic_cosmos <- d_filtered %>% filter(source == "Epic Cosmos")
d4_cdc_wisqars <- d_filtered %>% filter(source == "CDC/WISQARS")


#Group by Region
library(dplyr)

add_region <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      region = case_when(
        geography %in% c("Illinois", "Indiana", "Iowa", "Kansas", "Michigan", "Minnesota",
                         "Missouri", "Nebraska", "North Dakota", "Ohio", "South Dakota", "Wisconsin") ~ "Midwest",
        geography %in% c("Connecticut", "Maine", "Massachusetts", "New Hampshire", "New Jersey",
                         "New York", "Pennsylvania", "Rhode Island", "Vermont") ~ "Northeast",
        geography %in% c("Alaska", "Arizona", "California", "Colorado", "Hawaii", "Idaho",
                         "Montana", "Nevada", "New Mexico", "Oregon", "Utah", "Washington", "Wyoming") ~ "West",
        geography %in% c("Alabama", "Arkansas", "Delaware", "District of Columbia", "Florida", "Georgia",
                         "Kentucky", "Louisiana", "Maryland", "Mississippi", "North Carolina", "Oklahoma",
                         "South Carolina", "Tennessee", "Texas", "Virginia", "West Virginia") ~ "South",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
}

d4_epic_cosmos  <- add_region(d4_epic_cosmos)
d4_cdc_wisqars  <- add_region(d4_cdc_wisqars)

# Remove rows where region == "Other"
#d4_epic_cosmos <- d4_epic_cosmos %>% filter(region != "Other")
#d4_cdc_wisqars <- d4_cdc_wisqars %>% filter(region != "Other")

#Plot graphs
plot_region_ts <- function(df, title) {
  df %>%
    group_by(year, region) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = value, color = region)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Year",
      y = "Value",
      color = "Region"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}


p4_cosmos    <- plot_region_ts(d4_epic_cosmos, "Epic Cosmos: Opioid-related ED visits by Region")
p4_wisqars   <- plot_region_ts(d4_cdc_wisqars, "CDC/WISQARS: Overdose-related deaths by Region")

ggplotly(p4_cosmos)
ggplotly(p4_wisqars)
```

```{r}
library(geofacet)
# plots of Overdose Death Rate Trends by State (2015–2025)

theme_update(text = element_text(family = "Inter"))

library(geofacet)


d6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(geography), geography != "United States") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = rate_deaths_overdose)) +
  geom_line(color = "#29125a", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ geography, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(
    title = "Overdose Death Rate Trends by State (2015–2025)",
    subtitle = "Each panel shows monthly overdose mortality trends for a single state",
    caption = "Source: CDC WISQARS; rates per 100,000 population",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Deaths per 100,000"
  ) +
  PopHivePlots:::theme_pophive_line() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

# Function to create faceted ggplot for age groups
plot_age_ts <- function(df, title) {
  df %>%
    filter(geography == "United States") %>%
    group_by(year, age) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = value, color = age)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
      labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Year",
      y = "Value",
      color = "Age Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10)
)
}

# Build the two ggplots
g_wisqars <- plot_age_ts(d4_cdc_wisqars, "CDC/WISQARS: Overdose-related deaths by Age Group")
g_cosmos  <- plot_age_ts(d4_epic_cosmos, "Epic Cosmos: Opioid-related ED visits Trends by Age Group")

# Convert to interactive plotly objects
p_wisqars_interactive <- ggplotly(g_wisqars)
p_cosmos_interactive  <- ggplotly(g_cosmos)

# Display
p_wisqars_interactive
p_cosmos_interactive
```

```{r line-example, eval=FALSE}
### Line Graph

library(PopHivePlots)
library(ggplot2)

# Setup fonts
setup_pophive_fonts()

# Sample data
df_line <- data.frame(
  year = rep(2015:2024, 3),
  value = c(runif(10, 20, 50), runif(10, 30, 60), runif(10, 25, 55)),
  category = rep(c("Category A", "Category B", "Category C"), each = 10)
)

# Create line plot
pophive_plot(
  data = df_line,
  plot_type = "line",
  aes_mappings = aes(x = year, y = value, color = category, linetype = category),
  title = "Trends Over Time",
  subtitle = "Example line graph with custom PopHIVE theme",
  caption = "Data source: sample data",
  x_label = "Year",
  y_label = "Value",
  line_width = 0.8
)
```

```{r, PopHive plots}
library(PopHivePlots)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

#setup_pophive_fonts()

plot_region_ts_pophive <- function(df, title) {
  
  df_line <- df %>%
    group_by(year, region) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

  p <- pophive_plot(
    data = df_line,
    plot_type = "line",
    aes_mappings = aes(
      x = year,
      y = value,
      color = region,
      linetype = region
    ),
    title = title,
    subtitle = "Regional overdose trends",
    caption = "Data source: PopHIVE pipeline",
    x_label = "Year",
    y_label = "Value",
    line_width = 0.9
  )

  # Make interactive
  ggplotly(p)
}

p4_cosmos <- plot_region_ts_pophive(
  d4_epic_cosmos,
  "Epic Cosmos: Opioid-related ED Visits by Region"
)
p4_cosmos

p4_wisqars <- plot_region_ts_pophive(
  d4_cdc_wisqars,
  "CDC/WISQARS: Overdose Deaths by Region"
)
p4_wisqars

```

```{r}
library(PopHivePlots)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(ggstar)

pophive_region_cols <- c(
  "Northeast" = "#29125a",
  "Midwest"   = "#6b1d80",
  "South"     = "#ad347c",
  "West"      = "#e95661"
)

df_dot <- d4_epic_cosmos %>% filter(region != "Other", age == "Total")

p <- ggplot(df_dot) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = factor(year),
      y = value,
      color = region,
       text = paste0(
        "State: ", geography, "<br>",
        "Region: ", region, "<br>",
        "Year: ", year, "<br>",
       "Value: ", round(value, 1)
      )
      ),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pophive_region_cols) +
  PopHivePlots:::theme_pophive_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Epic Cosmos: State-level ED Visits (per 100,000)",
    subtitle = "Non-fatal and fatal emergency department visits related to overdoses (T40.*)
    Each dot = one state; grouped by year, separated by region",
    caption = "Source: Epic Cosmos; cases per 100,000 population",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Cases per 100,000"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 600),
    breaks = seq(0, 600, by = 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))
  )+
  theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )
```

```{r}
library(PopHivePlots)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(patchwork)


pophive_region_cols <- c(
  "Northeast" = "#29125a",
  "Midwest"   = "#6b1d80",
  "South"     = "#ad347c",
  "West"      = "#e95661"
)

df_dot2 <- d4_cdc_wisqars %>% 
  filter(region != "Other", year %in% 0:2025, age== "Total")


p2 <- ggplot(df_dot2) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = factor(year),
      y = value,
      color = region,
      text = paste0(
        "State: ", geography, "<br>",
        "Region: ", region, "<br>",
        "Year: ", year, "<br>",
       "Value: ", round(value, 1)
      )
    ),

    alpha = 0.8,
```

```{r}
  filter(highlight == "highlight") %>%
  group_by(geography) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup()

pophive_plot(
  data = filter(st_highlighted, highlight == "other"),
  plot_type = "line",
  aes_mappings = aes(x = year, y = value, group = geography),
  title = "Epic Cosmos: State-level ED visits by U.S. Region Over Time",
  subtitle = "Highlighted states: Ohio (Midwest), West Virginia (South), Maine (Northeast), Alaska (West)",
  caption = "Data source: Epic Cosmos",
  x_label = "Year",
  y_label = "Cases per 100,000",
  line_width = 0.6,
  line_color = "grey70"
) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(st_highlighted, highlight == "highlight"),
    aes(x = year, y = value, group = geography),
    color = "#e95661", linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = st_labels_top,
    aes(x = year, y = value, label = geography),
    color = "#00356b",
    size = 6,
    nudge_x = 1,
    nudge_y = 1.5,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    segment.color = "grey50"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ region, ncol = 2) +
  PopHivePlots:::theme_pophive_line() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```
